lines.en: label bar55:
scene sanakaoribar1
I make my way over to the bar (The regular one, not the second bar that I secretly visit on Fridays now) and find that, for some reason, Kaori is working here again.
lines.zh: 我走到酒吧（就是平时那家，不是我现在周五偷偷去的第二家），结果发现不知为何 Kaori 又在这儿上班了。

lines.en: I’m not sure why, considering that today is, at least to my knowledge, not a special occasion or holiday.  But I’m also not about to put any amount of thought into why Kaori does...well, anything.
lines.zh: 我也不知道为什么，据我所知今天既不是什么特别的日子，也不是节假日。不过我也懒得去琢磨 Kaori 为什么做……嗯，任何事。

lines.en: Instead, I’ll just focus on the small girl beside her.
lines.zh: 我还是把注意力放在她旁边那个小小的女孩身上吧。

lines.en: : Welcome once again, Friendburger! The special dizzy drink of the day is-
lines.zh: : 欢迎再次光临，朋友堡！今日特供晕眩饮料是——

lines.en: : Hey, Sana. Working alone again tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sana。今晚又是一个人看店？

lines.en: : So far...not really...
lines.zh: : 目前……不算……

lines.en: : Kaori keeps helping the customers before I...even have a chance to...
lines.zh: : Kaori 总是抢在我……有机会之前……就把客人招待了……

lines.en: : Kaori? Is she here right now?
lines.zh: : Kaori？她现在在这儿吗？

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar2
: Do not give into the foul temptations of your sight balls’ endless longing for the dark! The Queen of Spiders stands before you! In the same place as always!
lines.zh: : 不要屈服于你的眼球对黑暗那无止境的邪恶渴望！蛛后正站在你面前！就在老地方！

lines.en: : Always? You’ve worked here like three times.
lines.zh: : 老地方？你在这儿才上了三次班吧。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar3
: So you {i}can{/i} see.
lines.zh: : 这么说你{i}还{/i}看得见。

lines.en: : That was not a very funny human joke, Friend. Invisibility is a terrifying sickness that comes to claim us all one day. I was worried my time may have expired for a sixtieth of a minute.
lines.zh: : 这个人类笑话一点也不好笑，朋友。隐形是一种可怕的疾病，总有一天会来把我们全部带走。我还担心自己已经失效了六十分之一分钟。

lines.en: : That...would be called a “second...”
lines.zh: : 那……应该叫“一秒”吧……

lines.en: : Thank you, Sana- for taking up my role as Kaori’s unofficial human tutor. It feels like just yesterday that I was coming here to teach {i}you{/i} how to be human.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Sana——接手了我这个 Kaori 非官方人类导师的位子。感觉就在昨天，我还是来这儿教{i}你{/i}怎么做人的。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar4
: Is that...why you were coming here? It wasn’t...to teach me how to be more...umm...confident when it comes to...speaking?
lines.zh: : 你……来这儿就是为了这个吗？不是……为了教我在……嗯……说话的时候更……自信一点？

lines.en: : If you want my human opinion, I think your speaking is nice. Your voice reminds me of glass and the color periwinkle.
lines.zh: : 如果你想听我这个人类的意见，我觉得你说话很好听。你的声音让我想起玻璃，还有长春花的颜色。

lines.en: : Confidence...humanity...they’re kind of interchangeable at this point, I think. That’s why it’s okay for people like Kaori to breathe the same air as us.
lines.zh: : 自信……人性……到这个地步，我觉得这俩词差不多可以互换了。所以像 Kaori 这样的人跟我们呼吸同一片空气也没问题。

lines.en: : She never makes any sense, but her confidence in the act of {i}making{/i} no sense helps her blend in pretty well.
lines.zh: : 她说话从来没有逻辑，可她{i}没{/i}逻辑时的那份自信，反而让她混得挺好。

lines.en: : On the other end of the spectrum, you have zero confidence, but are also one of the most unremarkable and exceedingly average human beings I have ever encountered.
lines.zh: : 而在另一个极端，你一点自信都没有，但同时你又是我见过的最不起眼、最平平无奇的人类之一。

lines.en: : You don’t have to blend in at all since you’re already a part of the background.
lines.zh: : 你根本不用去融入，因为你自己就是背景的一部分。

lines.en: : So I guess that, in a sense, my job here is done. You’re as human as you’ll ever be.
lines.zh: : 所以我想，从某种意义上说，我的活儿干完了。你已经是你能达到的最像人的程度了。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar5
: Un...remarkable?...
: Exceedingly...average?...
lines.zh: : 最……平平无奇？……

lines.en: : Are you...calling me...boring?...
lines.zh: : 你是在说……我很无聊吗？……

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar6
: W...Why?! Did you come here just to...hurt me?!
lines.zh: : 为、为什么？！你来这儿就是为了……伤害我吗？！

lines.en: : Hey, being boring isn’t bad. I like being with you because it’s relaxing and I never have to worry about you drugging me or threatening to tie me up and do things to my body.
lines.zh: : 嘿，无聊又不是坏事。我喜欢跟你待在一起，因为很放松，而且我完全不用担心你会给我下药，或者威胁把我绑起来对我的身体做些什么。

lines.en: : Who are you spending your time with that makes you worry about those things?!
lines.zh: : 你平时都跟些什么人待在一起，才会担心这种事？！

lines.en: : Pretty much everyone. Which is why I like you. It’s a nice change of pace.
lines.zh: : 基本所有人。所以我才喜欢你。换个节奏挺好的。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar7
: This is the strangest...compliment I’ve ever received...
lines.zh: : 这是我收到过……最奇怪的……夸奖……

lines.en: : And you say that I am bad at human conversation, Friend. Can you not see that you are making the tiny human uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 朋友，你还说我不懂人类对话。你没看到你把那个小小的人类弄得不舒服了吗？

lines.en: : I’m not...uncomfortable...I...
lines.zh: : 我没有……不舒服……我……

lines.en: : I think I am...offended...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我是……生气了……

lines.en: : Offended?
lines.zh: : 生气？

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar8
: Y...Yes.
lines.zh: : 是、是的。

lines.en: : You made me mad...and...
lines.zh: : 你把我惹火了……而且……

lines.en: : And for that...you will pay.
lines.zh: : 为此……你要付出代价。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar9
: Hah...I tried...being intimidating to...change things up, but...I...just sounded stupid...didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 哈……我试着……装出吓人的样子……换个风格，可……我……听起来就是很蠢……对吧？

lines.en: : You did not sound like yourself. The mini Sara spawn that I know of is never intimidating. Like a tiny gerbil but with marshmallows for teeth and only one eyeball.
lines.zh: : 那听起来一点也不像你。我认识的那个迷你 Sara 后代从来都不可怕。就像一只小沙鼠，只不过牙齿是棉花糖做的，而且只有一只眼球。

lines.en: : I’ll just accept that...my test of “humanity” is finally complete and...that Sensei has no use for me anymore...
lines.zh: : 那我就接受吧……我的“人性”测试终于完成了……Sensei 已经用不上我了……

lines.en: : To be completely honest, though...you have improved a lot. In terms of speaking, I mean. Which I will now clarify as the {i}actual{/i} purpose of all of these visits.
lines.zh: : 不过说实话……你进步很大。我是说说话方面。我现在正式澄清，这才是{i}真正{/i}的目的，我这一趟趟跑来的。

lines.en: : And in a sense...I think your test {i}is{/i} complete. But that doesn’t mean I don’t have any more use for you.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说……我觉得你的测试{i}确实{/i}完成了。但这不代表我对你就没有别的用处了。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar10
: C...Complete?...
lines.zh: : 完……完成了？……

lines.en: : But I still...
lines.zh: : 可我还是……

lines.en: : Keep...pausing...in the middle of...sentences...
lines.zh: : 还是会……在句子中间……停顿……

lines.en: : Yeah, but I think that just might be how you talk. When you look at the amount you’ve {i}accomplished{/i} since we’ve met one another, it’s a lot more than most.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但我觉得那大概就是你说话的方式。你看我们认识以来你{i}做到{/i}的事，比大多数人都多得多。

lines.en: : You’ve made a bunch of friends...you can stand next to Kaori without getting scared...Hell, you’ve even joined the light music club.
lines.zh: : 你交了一堆朋友……你能站在 Kaori 旁边不害怕了……见鬼，你甚至还加入了轻音部。

lines.en: : That’s a lot, Sana. I’m really proud of-
lines.zh: : 这已经很多了，Sana。我真的为你感到——

lines.en: : Light music club?!
lines.zh: : 轻音部？！

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar11
: Since when are you in the light music club?! Since when are you in any club at all?! Why didn’t you tell me?!
lines.zh: : 你什么时候进了轻音部？！你什么时候进过任何社团？！你为什么不告诉我？！

lines.en: : I didn’t tell you b...because I knew you would...act like this...
lines.zh: : 我没告诉你，是、是因为我就知道你会……这个样子……

lines.en: : Like what?! Excited that my little girl is finally finding her place in the world?!
lines.zh: : 什么样子？！为我家的乖女儿终于在世界上找到了自己的位置而激动吗？！

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar12
: Why have you been hiding my daughter’s character growth from me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一直瞒着我女儿的角色成长？

lines.en: : Why is it up to me to relay her growth to you?
lines.zh: : 为什么这事儿该由我来向你汇报她的成长？

lines.en: : Why are we...still talking about {i}me?...{/i}I would like to...go back to being...unremarkable now...
lines.zh: : 为什么我们……还在聊{i}我？……{/i}我想……变回……不起眼的样子了……

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar13
: Absolutely not! You are {i}my{/i} daughter and the world will know of your adorableness! I don’t care if I have to burn down all of Kumon-mi to show them.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！你是{i}我{/i}的女儿，全世界都要知道你有多可爱！就算要我把整个 Kumon-mi 烧了给他们看，我也在所不惜。

lines.en: : Please don’t...burn down the city for me...This summer is already...hot enough...
lines.zh: : 求你别……为了我把城市烧了……这个夏天已经……够热了……

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar14
: Sara, I get that you like your daughter and that’s totally chill. But I ain’t afraid of kickin’ your ass if you burn down both my job and apartment. I ain’t goin’ back to the streets, you hear me?
lines.zh: : Sara，我知道你喜欢你女儿，这完全没问题。可你要是把我的饭碗和住处一起烧了，我可不介意揍你一顿。我可不想再回街头了，听明白了吗？

lines.en: : Shut up. If you can be proud of your daughter for putting some girl into a coma, I can be proud of my baby for becoming a rock star.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。你能为自己女儿把某个姑娘打得进了昏迷而骄傲，我就能为我家宝贝要当摇滚明星而骄傲。

lines.en: : M...Mom! I...don’t even know how to...play anything yet...
lines.zh: : 妈、妈！我……连一件乐器都还不会……

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar15
: {i}Yet!{/i} Which means you {i}will!{/i} And I don’t care if I have to burn down all of Kumon-mi to ensure that!
lines.zh: : {i}还不会！{/i}那就意味着你{i}会！{/i}就算要我把整个 Kumon-mi 烧了来保证这一点，我也在所不惜！

lines.en: : Where did this sudden fascination with arson come from?
lines.zh: : 你这股对纵火的执念是哪来的？

lines.en: : From the burning love I feel for my mini Sara spawn.
lines.zh: : 源自我对我家迷你 Sara 后代燃烧般炽热的爱。

lines.en: : I have a name! And can we stop talking about me now?!
lines.zh: : 我有名字的！还有我们能别再聊我了吗？！

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar16
Sara decides to give her daughter a break and retreats to the corner of the bar with Yuki after she finishes dealing with a table full of customers.
lines.zh: Sara 决定放过她女儿一马，招呼完满满一桌客人后，和 Yuki 一起退到了酒吧的角落。

lines.en: It’s not much being just {i}one{/i} table, but it’s more than usual for a random school night.
lines.zh: {i}区区{/i}一桌客人不算什么，但在一个普通的上学日夜晚，这已经比平时多了。

lines.en: And if Sara can afford having four people on shift at once, I think it’s safe to say things might actually be turning around for the Sakakibaras.
lines.zh: 既然 Sara 都请得起四个人同时当班了，我觉得基本可以说，Sakakibara 家的日子可能真的在好转了。

lines.en: With the youngest of them managing to turn things around for herself as well, I can’t help but feel something reminiscent of what normal people would call “happiness” bubbling up inside of me.
lines.zh: 连家里最小的那个也为自己扭转了局面，我不禁感到一种类似正常人所说的“幸福”的东西从心底冒了出来。

lines.en: But then again, I could just be lightheaded from having so many attractive girls in matching outfits standing in close proximity to me.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，也可能只是因为这么多穿同款制服的漂亮姑娘围在我身边，让我有点头晕。

lines.en: You’d think the novelty of that would have worn off by now, but...nope.
lines.zh: 你以为这种新鲜感早该消退了，可……并没有。

lines.en: : If you do not want us to talk about you, what do you suggest we speak of, mini Sara spawn?
lines.zh: : 既然你不想让我们聊你，那你建议我们聊什么呢，迷你 Sara 后代？

lines.en: : The lack of patrons in this establishment signals to me that this would be a good opportunity to become close to one another as I will be standing in this spot more frequently going forward.
lines.zh: : 这家店里客人的稀少向我表明，现在是彼此拉近距离的好机会，因为往后我会更频繁地站在这个位置上。

lines.en: : You will?
lines.zh: : 你会吗？

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar17
: The time has come for a new companion! One that I must acquire additional moneys for! And also because being around Aunt Yukiburger makes me happy!
lines.zh: : 是时候找个新伙伴了！我需要为此攒下更多的钱！而且和 Yukiburger 阿姨待在一起让我很开心！

lines.en: : I’m also...going to have to spend more time with my club, so...I won’t be able to help out around here as much anymore...
lines.zh: : 我……也得花更多时间在社团上，所以……以后就没法像以前那样常来帮忙了……

lines.en: : Having Kaori help is...well...it’s a lot of things...but I...think it will be for the best...
lines.zh: : 让 Kaori 来帮忙……嗯……怎么说呢……但……我觉得这样最好……

lines.en: : Think you’ll be able to survive a room full of loud, energetic girls playing what I assume will be loud, energetic music?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能扛得住满屋子吵吵闹闹、活力四射的姑娘，演奏我猜同样吵闹、同样活力四射的音乐吗？

lines.en: : The music...I don’t mind...but it might be...hard fitting in with everyone at first since...they’re all so cool and I’m...umm...what was it again?...
lines.zh: : 音乐……我不介意……但一开始要融入大家可能有点难，因为……她们都很酷，而我……嗯……我该怎么说来着？……

lines.en: : Unremarkable and exceedingly average?
lines.zh: : 不起眼又平平无奇？

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar18
: R...Right...
: You seem to care a lot for the mini Sara spawn, Friend. Is this what humans call love?
lines.zh: : 朋友，你似乎很在乎这个迷你 Sara 后代。这就是人类所说的爱吗？

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar19
: Wh-What?! No! Of...Of course not!
lines.zh: : 什、什么？！不！当、当然不是！

lines.en: : Then why is the temperature of your tiny human body steadily rising?
lines.zh: : 那你这小小的人类身体为什么在持续升温？

lines.en: : Size has naught to do with reaching sexual maturity, mini Sara. Not when cats are primed and ready to reproduce at only four months old!
lines.zh: : 体型跟性成熟毫无关系，迷你 Sara。猫可是出生才四个月就能准备繁殖了！

lines.en: : That’s...way too young!
lines.zh: : 那……也太小了吧！

lines.en: : Yeah, that just made me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这话让我很不舒服。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar20
: There is no reason to feel discomfort, Friend! Intercourse creates more fluffy animals and if you want to create more animals with the Sara spawn, I think you should!
lines.zh: : 朋友，完全没必要觉得不舒服！性交能造出更多毛茸茸的小动物，如果你想和这位 Sara 后代一起造更多小动物，我觉得你应该去做！

lines.en: : Sana-
lines.zh: : Sana——

lines.en: : No! Absolutely not! I am not...looking for a...mate!
lines.zh: : 不！绝对不行！我才没有……在找……交配对象！

lines.en: : I was just going to ask if you loved me like Kaori suggested.
lines.zh: : 我只是想问你，是不是像 Kaori 说的那样爱我。

lines.en: : I don’t even {i}like{/i} you!
lines.zh: : 我连{i}喜欢{/i}你都谈不上！

lines.en: : Well, that’s just rude.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话可真伤人。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar21
: That’s...not what I...
lines.zh: : 我……不是那个意思……

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar22
: So, uhh...animals! Right?
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……动物！对吧？

lines.en: : Would you like to learn more about the rituals of mating and-
lines.zh: : 你想了解更多关于交配仪式的内容吗——

lines.en: : Nope! Something...entirely unrelated to that!
lines.zh: : 不要！来点……完全无关的！

lines.en: : Baby animals?
lines.zh: : 小动物宝宝？

lines.en: sa" Uhh...closer...but still not what I had in-"
lines.zh: sa“呃……更接近了……但还是不是我想说的——”

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar23
: What is your favorite baby animal, Friend? They are all good and there are no wrong answers. So please answer correctly!
lines.zh: : 朋友，你最喜欢的小动物宝宝是什么？它们全都很好，没有错误答案。所以请务必答对！

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Too slow! The correct answer is the baby sea turtle!
lines.zh: : 太慢了！正确答案是海龟宝宝！

lines.en: : Did you know that in a single nesting season, sea turtles can lay over one thousand eggs?!
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，在一个筑巢季里，海龟能产下一千多枚卵？！

lines.en: : That is so much egg! Glorious egg!
lines.zh: : 那可是好多蛋！光荣的蛋！

lines.en: : I wonder if...Koi Cafe is hiring?...
lines.zh: : 我在想……Koi Cafe 还招人吗？……

lines.en: : My favorite baby animal is the lamb because all of the bad things you do in life can be forgiven by ritualistically sacrificing one.
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢的小动物宝宝是羊羔，因为你这辈子干过的所有坏事，都能靠仪式性地献祭一只来得到赦免。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar24

: Without the shedding of blood, there is no forgiveness of sin. And while sacrifices at the behest of  gods run deeper than the rivers of our ancestry, our ability to accept and embrace them does not.
lines.zh: : 若不流血，罪就不得赦免。虽然诸神所要求的献祭比我们先祖的河流还要深远，可我们接受并拥抱它们的能力却并非如此。

lines.en: : A long time ago, a group of men in suits showed up at my doorstep. We took them in and fed them after wiping the blood from our hands and were swiftly rewarded with eternal life.
lines.zh: : 很久以前，一群西装革履的人出现在我家门口。我们擦掉手上的血，把他们迎进门招待吃喝，很快便得到了永生的奖赏。

lines.en: : That is why I can still smile today. Why I can drink and be merry. Why I can stand before you two in my purest form.
lines.zh: : 那就是为什么我今天还能微笑。为什么我还能饮酒作乐。为什么我能以最纯粹的形态站在你们两个面前。

lines.en: : I am eternal. All of this exists for me.
lines.zh: : 我是永恒的。这一切都是为了我而存在。

lines.en: : And none of it would be possible without a pile of lifeless baby sheep and blood smeared over the door of my home to attract more visitors.
lines.zh: : 而如果没有那一堆死掉的羊羔宝宝，没有抹在我家门框上用来招徕更多来客的血，这一切都不可能实现。

lines.en: : I can’t wait to have sex with both of you at the same time.
lines.zh: : 我等不及要同时跟你们两个上床了。

lines.en: scene black
INCORRECT RESPONSE PROVIDED.
lines.zh: 回答错误。

lines.en: THE EVENT WILL NOW REVERT TO ITS PREVIOUS STATE.
lines.zh: 本事件将恢复至先前的状态。

lines.en: PLEASE BE ADVISED THAT THIS PROCESS IS STILL UNDERGOING TESTING AND THAT ADDITIONAL ABNORMALITIES MAY OCCUR.
lines.zh: 请注意，此流程仍在测试阶段，可能会出现其他异常。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar24
: I wonder if...Koi Cafe is-
lines.zh: : 我在想……Koi Cafe 是不是——

lines.en: : I concur that the ideal baby animal is the sea turtle. Oh, glorious egg.
lines.zh: : 我同意，最理想的小动物宝宝是海龟。哦，光荣的蛋。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar25
: You did it! You got it right! Congratulations!
lines.zh: : 你做到了！你答对了！恭喜！

lines.en: : I...really don’t like when you two...speak...like that...
lines.zh: : 我……真的很不喜欢你们两个……那样……说话……

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 怎样？

lines.en: : Like...saying things that don’t really make sense...
lines.zh: : 就是……说些根本没道理的话……

lines.en: : It makes me...a little uncomfortable...like...like something...weird is...
lines.zh: : 那让我……有点不舒服……好像……好像有什么……奇怪的东西……

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar26
: Is...going on...
lines.zh: : 正在……发生……

lines.en: : There is nothing weird about the baby sea turtle, mini Sara! They are at their most adorable when they have to flip-flap flip-flap across black sandy beaches, dodging talons of predators along the way.
lines.zh: : 海龟宝宝一点都不奇怪，迷你 Sara！它们最可爱的时候，就是在一片片黑色沙滩上啪嗒啪嗒地爬，一路上还要躲开捕食者的利爪。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar27
: In a sense, that is what we all do every day in this human life!
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说，我们每个人在这人类的一生里，每天都在做同样的事！

lines.en: : We wake up and slide our fleshy motion tubes out of our soft rectangle, hoping that the giant welcome box we live in does not dissolve into the earth!
lines.zh: : 我们醒来，把肉做的运动管从柔软的长方体上滑下来，心里盼着我们住的巨大欢迎箱不会消融进土地里！

lines.en: : Then, we pour ourselves a deep ceramic plate of sugar squares coated in cow juice to ward off the evil as we make our way into the world itself!
lines.zh: : 然后，我们给自己倒上一深陶瓷盘的、裹着牛奶的方糖，用来驱邪，好踏上进入这个世界本身的旅程！

lines.en: : But before we can leave, we have to stare back at ourselves!
lines.zh: : 但在出门之前，我们得先回头凝视自己！

lines.en: : Thank our organs and remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 感谢我们的器官，并且记得微笑！

lines.en: : For the moment we forget to do those things, the welcome box becomes an {i}unwelcome{/i} box.
lines.zh: : 因为一旦我们忘了做这些事，欢迎箱就会变成一个{i}不欢迎{/i}箱。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar28
: And it all decays from there.
lines.zh: : 然后一切就从此腐朽下去。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar29
: What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干嘛？

lines.en: : Who, me? Oh, you know...Just being irresponsible with my money and buying Sana a drum set as an early Christmas present.
lines.zh: : 谁，我吗？哦，你知道的……就是不负责任地花钱，给 Sana 买套架子鼓当提前的圣诞礼物。

lines.en: : Oh, shit.
lines.zh: : 哦，靠。

lines.en: : Here’s hoping she ain’t a piece of shit like my daughter and doesn’t toss it off a bridge.
lines.zh: : 只希望她别像我女儿那么混蛋，把这玩意儿从桥上扔下去。

lines.en: : I doubt she’ll be strong enough to lift it. Us Sakakibaras aren’t exactly known for our {i}strength.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我怀疑她力气不够，举不起来。我们 Sakakibara 家的人可不以{i}力气{/i}著称。

lines.en: : What {i}are{/i} you known for, then? Apart from running the least popular bar in all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 那你们以{i}什么{/i}著称？除了经营全 Kumon-mi 最没人气的酒吧之外。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar30
: Hmm...
scene sanakaoribar31
: Wanting to fuck our teachers?
lines.zh: : 想跟我们的老师上床？

lines.en: : Dude.
lines.zh: : 老兄。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar32
: So, Sana...you’ve made new friends...joined a club...and can now (At least partially) conquer a conversation with the single most confusing person I have ever encountered.
lines.zh: : 那么，Sana……你交了新朋友……加入了社团……现在还能（至少部分地）搞定跟我见过的、最让人摸不着头脑的那个人的对话。

lines.en: : Would it be preemptive to label today’s meeting as a graduation and finally put an end to your training arc?
lines.zh: : 把今天这次会面称作毕业，就此给你的训练篇画上句号，会不会太早了点？

lines.en: : It...doesn’t feel like much of a...graduation and...and I still have a lot of improving to do, but...
lines.zh: : 这……感觉不太像……毕业……而且……我还有很多要进步的地方，不过……

lines.en: : If you think...I’ll be okay...then I’ll probably be okay...
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得……我会没事的……那我大概就会没事的……

lines.en: : Congratulations, mini Sara. Most people do not make it to the amount of words I was able to say to you. They always run away.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，迷你 Sara。大多数人撑不到我跟你说这么多话。他们总是会跑掉。

lines.en: : I will reward you by writing your name in my special notebook of friends. And, if you do not count animals, you are one of the first ten entries!
lines.zh: : 我要奖励你，把你的名字写进我那本特别的朋友笔记里。而且，如果不算动物的话，你是前十个条目之一！

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar33
: Uhh...thanks...but I...I don’t really...need a reward for...existing...
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢……可我……我真的不需要……因为活着……拿奖励……

lines.en: : How about a drink then?
lines.zh: : 那来杯喝的怎么样？

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar34
: Why do all of the adults I know always encourage me to drink?...
lines.zh: : 为什么我认识的大人都总是怂恿我喝酒？……

lines.en: : I will not allow the mini Sara to consume the dizzy drinks on my watch.
lines.zh: : 在我眼皮底下，我绝不会让迷你 Sara 碰晕眩饮料。

lines.en: : She may have reached the age of sexual maturity, but is still far too young to partake in an activity as hellacious as the consumption of alcohol!
lines.zh: : 她也许已经到了性成熟的年纪，但要参与饮酒这种罪大恶极的活动，还远远太年轻了！

lines.en: : You may reward her with a child instead.
lines.zh: : 你可以改用一个孩子来奖励她。

lines.en: : I...think I’m going to refuse...both of those things...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得这两样……我都要拒绝……

lines.en: : I...talk too much when I drink and...and I want to start...talking...{i}without{/i} that...
lines.zh: : 我……一喝酒话就特别多……而、而我想学着……{i}不靠{/i}那个……也能说话……

lines.en: : Then...I guess it’ll just be an entirely unceremonious graduation and we’ll all go on with our lives in the exact same fashion we’ve been going about them thus far.
lines.zh: : 那……我想这就是一场完全没有仪式的毕业典礼了，我们大家就照着一直以来的方式，继续过各自的日子。

lines.en: scene sanakaoribar35
: By dodging the talons of predators!
lines.zh: : 靠躲开捕食者的利爪！

lines.en: : Dodging the talons of predators...
lines.zh: : 躲开捕食者的利爪……

lines.en: scene black
The three of us make a toast, but I am the only one who drinks.
lines.zh: 我们三个举杯，但只有我一个人喝了。

lines.en: That is, until Sara and Yuki rejoin me and the rest of the night goes by with us constantly asking Kaori for refills.
lines.zh: 至少在 Sara 和 Yuki 重新加入我之前是这样，之后的一整晚，我们就在不停找 Kaori 续杯中度过了。

lines.en: Sana goes home somewhere around my third or fourth beer, but I don’t see her leave.
lines.zh: Sana 在我喝到第三还是第四杯啤酒的时候回家了，可我没看见她走。

lines.en: Around my sixth, I begin to wonder if it has anything to do with the fact that she’s already accustomed to never saying goodbye to those she cares about.
lines.zh: 到第六杯左右，我开始想，这会不会跟她早已习惯了从不跟自己在乎的人道别有关。

lines.en: Around my ninth, I think of a lamb.
lines.zh: 到第九杯左右，我想起了一只羊羔。

lines.en: Though, I’m not quite sure why.
lines.zh: 不过，我也不太清楚为什么。

$ bar55 = True
{i}Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!{/i}
